description.en: Jojo does not want to share his floatie with Rhodey, and Rhodey is crying in the background. Jojo needs a simple question while Rhodey needs comfort right away.
description.id: Jojo tidak mau berbagi pelampung dengan Rhodey, dan Rhodey menangis di belakang. Jojo perlu pertanyaan sederhana sementara Rhodey perlu ditenangkan segera.

completionSummary.en: Jojo needed a simple question to notice how Rhodey felt, while Rhodey needed comfort right away.
completionSummary.id: Jojo perlu pertanyaan sederhana agar menyadari perasaan Rhodey, sementara Rhodey perlu ditenangkan segera.

completionTip.en: When a child will not share or give something up, ask a simple question about how the other person might be feeling.
completionTip.id: Saat anak tidak mau berbagi atau melepas sesuatu, ajukan pertanyaan sederhana tentang bagaimana perasaan orang lain.

completedOneStar.id: Jojo dan Rhodey merasa lebih baik.

hints.en: A child may be more willing to share once they have thought about how the other person feels.
hints.id: Anak bisa lebih mau berbagi setelah memikirkan perasaan orang lain.

placementLimitMessage.en: Jojo and Rhodey are tired. You took too long.
placementLimitMessage.id: Jojo dan Rhodey kelelahan. Kamu terlalu lama.

caregiverLine.en: Rhodey feels sad because he wanted to play too.
caregiverLine.id: Rhodey sedih karena ia juga ingin bermain.

caregiverLine.en: Jojo, what do you think Rhodey feels?
You must share because that is the rule.
caregiverLine.id: Kamu harus berbagi karena itu aturannya.

caregiverLine.en: Rhodey, I know you really wanted a turn.
caregiverLine.id: Rhodey, aku tahu kamu sangat ingin giliran.

caregiverLine.en: The floatie can be used together or by taking turns.
caregiverLine.id: Pelampungnya bisa dipakai bersama atau bergantian.
